messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired for service=redwood-inference-eu — high error rate + tail latency spike. PD: https://pagerduty.local/INC123456 • alert: 500_rate > 8% (5m), p50=120ms p99=2.3s. severity: SEV2. Please ack.

sasha: acked and taking this one. opening quick bridge now. @devon @ben FYI.

devon: joining bridge in ~2m. checking deploys and recent config changes. nothing in last 30m from my side.

ben: seeing a concentration of 502s from embedder-host-07. snippet from logs: ```[2026-03-16T12:34:01Z] embedder-host-07 embedder_service: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted message="queue full"```

lina: metrics: KV cache evictions on eu-cluster-1 jumped x10 around the same time. also a small spike in memory pressure on nodes. (chart link: https://grafana.local/d/abc/embedder-evictions)

sasha: ok — mitigation plan: scale embedder pool +2 instances, enable fallback routing to cpu-embedder for low-priority requests, and apply a short per-user rate limit to reduce burstiness. I'll kick off scale now.

incidentbot: infra request accepted: requested scale embedder-eu +2, estimated warmup ~45s. (request id infra-789)

ben: recommend a temporary user rate-limit to 2rps (was 5rps). low-risk and should relieve queues. @sasha ok to patch? :thumbsup:

sasha: go ahead, apply the rate-limit. also enable model-fallback for /v1/embeddings route.

devon: rate-limit change pushed and fallback route enabled. watching traces.

lina: queue depth dropping already. 5xx rate went from 9% -> ~3.2% within 2 mins. p99 latency trending down.

ben: customer impact note: two large customers filed degraded-response tickets in the last 20m (TCK-2345, TCK-2346). CS notified; preparing short status message.

sasha: thanks — I'll post a short PSA to affected accounts and update PD with mitigation steps. marking incident as mitigated candidate.

incidentbot: PD INC123456 updated — status: acknowledged -> mitigation candidate. next action: monitor for 15m; if stable, resolve.

devon: will monitor for 30m. if error rate <1% for 15m we can rollback rate-limit to previous and scale back -2.

sasha: switching to monitoring mode. handing off post-mitigation followup to devon at +15 for RCA. great work team. :heart:
